-- ============================================================
-- paneer's Menu — WindUI
-- Todos los exploits confirmados integrados

-- Cargar WindUI
local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()

-- Servicios
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local RS = ReplicatedStorage

-- Packet library del juego
local Packets = require(RS.Utils.Packets)

-- Estado global
local state = {
    m1Auto = false,
    abilitySpam = false,
    dashSpam = false,
    blockSpam = false,
    wheelSpinSpam = false,
    confettiSpam = false,
    rainbowPortal = false,
    espEnabled = false,
    fovEnabled = false,
    zoomEnabled = false,
}

local espObjects = {}
local requestId = 0

-- ============================================================
-- FUNCIONES AUXILIARES
-- ============================================================

local function getChar()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    return char, char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getClosestEnemy(range)
    range = range or 12
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return nil end
    local closest, minDist = nil, range
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LP and p.Character then
            local php = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local phum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if php and phum and phum.Health > 0 then
                local dist = (php.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < minDist then
                    closest, minDist = php, dist
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

local function hsvToHex(h, s, v)
    return "#" .. Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v):ToHex()
end

-- ============================================================
-- CREAR VENTANA
-- ============================================================

local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
    Title = "paneer's Hub",
    Icon = "crown",
    Author = "by paneer",
    Folder = "paneersHub",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(580, 420),
    Transparent = true,
    Theme = "Dark",
    Resizable = true,
    SideBarWidth = 180,
    HideSearchBar = true,
    ScrollBarEnabled = false,
})

-- Tabs
local MainTab = Window:Tab({ Title = "Principal", Icon = "home" })
local CombatTab = Window:Tab({ Title = "Combate", Icon = "sword" })

-- ============================================================
-- TAB PRINCIPAL
-- ============================================================

local mainSection = MainTab:Section({ Title = "Estado", Opened = true })

mainSection:Button({
    Title = "Ver Morteys",
    Desc = "Busca el contador en la GUI",
    Callback = function()
        local PlayerGui = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        local found = false
        local function scan(inst, path, depth)
            if depth > 10 then return end
            path = path or ""
            if inst:IsA("TextLabel") or inst:IsA("TextButton") then
                local txt = inst.Text
                if txt and txt:match("^[%d,]+$") and #txt >= 3 then
                    print("[paneer] NUMERO: " .. path .. "." .. inst.Name .. " = " .. txt)
                    found = true
                end
            end
            for _, c in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
                scan(c, path .. "." .. inst.Name, depth + 1)
            end
        end
        scan(PlayerGui, "PlayerGui", 0)
        if not found then
            print("[paneer] No se encontraron números grandes en la GUI")
        end
    end,
})

mainSection:Button({

    Desc = "Envía los packets de todas las recompensas",
    Callback = function()

            pcall(function() Packets.PlaytimeRewards.ClaimReward:Fire(i) end)
            task.wait(0.3)
        end

            pcall(function() Packets.DailyRewards.ClaimReward:Fire(i) end)

    end,
})

rewardSection:Button({
    Title = "Verificar Pases",
    Desc = "Muestra si tienes los gamepasses",
    Callback = function()
        local passIds = {
            ["Custom Portal Color"] = 1979288487,
            ["VIP"] = 1853711135,
            ["Teleporter"] = 1853549088,
            ["x2 Speed"] = 1853099131,
        }
        for name, id in pairs(passIds) do
            pcall(function()
                local owned = Packets.Marketplace.CheckPassOwned:Fire(id, name)
                print("[paneer] " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(owned))
            end)
            task.wait(0.3)
        end
    end,
})

-- ============================================================
-- LOOPS DE EJECUCIÓN
-- ============================================================

-- M1 Auto + Aim
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.15) do
        if state.m1Auto then
            local char, hum, hrp = getChar()
            if char and hum and hum.Health > 0 and hrp then
                local target = getClosestEnemy(state.m1Range or 12)
                if target then
                    local lookPos = Vector3.new(target.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, target.Position.Z)
                    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, lookPos)
                end
                requestId = requestId + 1
                local CombatEvent = RS.Events.Combat:FindFirstChild("CombatEvent")
                if CombatEvent then
                    pcall(function()
                        CombatEvent:FireServer({
                            action = "Start",
                            gunMode = false,
                            requestId = requestId,
                            finisher = nil,
                            predictedStage = 1,
                            rootCFrame = hrp.CFrame,
                            sentAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
                        })
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Ability Spam
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1.5) do
        if state.abilitySpam then
            local AbilityAction = RS.Functions:FindFirstChild("AbilityAction")
            if AbilityAction then
                for _, ability in ipairs({"Special", "Ultimate"}) do
                    local ok, res = pcall(function()
                        return AbilityAction:InvokeServer("Activate", ability)
                    end)
                    if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.serial then
                        task.wait(0.3)
                        pcall(function()
                            AbilityAction:InvokeServer("Release", ability, res.serial)
                        end)
                    end
                    task.wait(0.3)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Dash Spam
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1.5) do
        if state.dashSpam then
            local DashEvent = RS.Events.Combat:FindFirstChild("DashEvent")
            if DashEvent then
                requestId = requestId + 1
                pcall(function() DashEvent:FireServer("Start", "Front", requestId) end)
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Block Spam
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.2) do
        if state.blockSpam then
            local BlockEvent = RS.Events.Combat:FindFirstChild("BlockEvent")
            if BlockEvent then
                pcall(function() BlockEvent:FireServer(true) end)
                task.wait(0.05)
                pcall(function() BlockEvent:FireServer(false) end)
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- WheelSpin Spam
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1) do
        if state.wheelSpinSpam then
            pcall(function() Packets.WheelSpin.Spin:Fire() end)
        end
    end
end)

-- Confetti Spam
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1.5) do
        if state.confettiSpam then
            pcall(function() Packets.Conffeti.Emit:Fire() end)
        end
    end
end)

-- Rainbow Portal
task.spawn(function()
    local hue = 0
    while true do
        local speed = state.rainbowSpeed or 0.08
        if state.rainbowPortal then
            hue = (hue + 0.008) % 1
            local hex = hsvToHex(hue, 1, 1)
            pcall(function() Packets.Settings.SavePortalColor:Fire(hex) end)
        end
        task.wait(speed)
    end
end)

-- ESP
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local function createESP(player)
    if player == LP or espObjects[player] then return end
    local box = Drawing.new("Square")
    box.Thickness = 1; box.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0); box.Filled = false; box.Visible = false
    local name = Drawing.new("Text")
    name.Size = 14; name.Center = true; name.Outline = true
    name.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255); name.Visible = false
    espObjects[player] = {box = box, name = name}
end
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do createESP(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(createESP)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
    if espObjects[p] then
        espObjects[p].box:Remove(); espObjects[p].name:Remove(); espObjects[p] = nil
    end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not state.espEnabled then
        for _, objs in pairs(espObjects) do
            objs.box.Visible = false; objs.name.Visible = false
        end
        return
    end
    for player, objs in pairs(espObjects) do
        local char = player.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
            local pos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
            if onScreen then
                local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if head then
                    local headPos = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
                    local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - pos.Y) * 1.8
                    local width = height / 2
                    objs.box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                    objs.box.Position = Vector2.new(pos.X - width/2, pos.Y - height/2)
                    objs.box.Visible = true
                    objs.name.Text = player.Name .. " [" .. math.floor(hum.Health) .. "]"
                    objs.name.Position = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y - height/2 - 20)
                    objs.name.Visible = true
                end
            else
                objs.box.Visible = false; objs.name.Visible = false
            end
        else
            objs.box.Visible = false; objs.name.Visible = false
        end
    end
end)

-- FOV + Zoom
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if state.fovEnabled and cam then
        local targetFOV = state.fovValue or 120
        if cam.FieldOfView ~= targetFOV then
            cam.FieldOfView = targetFOV
        end
    end
    if state.zoomEnabled then
        if LP.CameraMaxZoomDistance ~= 1000 then
            LP.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 1000
        end
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- NOTIFICACIÓN
-- ============================================================

WindUI:Notify({
    Title = "paneer's Hub",
    Content = "Menú cargado. Todos los exploits activos.",
    Duration = 5,
})

print("[paneer] Menú definitivo cargado")

    if NPCContainer and NPCContainer.Parent then return NPCContainer end

local function getESP(char)

local function updateESP()
    if not Cam then Cam = WS.CurrentCamera end
    if not Cam then return end
    if not Config.ESP.Enabled then
        for _, d in pairs(espDrawings) do hideESP(d) end
        return
    end
    local lPos = localPos()
    if not lPos then
        for _, d in pairs(espDrawings) do hideESP(d) end
        return
    end
    local seen = {}
    for _, t in ipairs(scanAll()) do
        if (t.IsNPC and Config.ESP.NPCs)
        or (not t.IsNPC and Config.ESP.Players) then
            seen[t.Character] = true
            local d = getESP(t.Character)
            local dist = (t.Root.Position - lPos).Magnitude
            if dist <= Config.ESP.MaxDist then
                local top = t.Head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
                local bot = t.Root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                local ts, on1 = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(top)
                local bs, on2 = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(bot)
                if on1 and on2 and ts.Z > 0 and bs.Z > 0 then
                    local h = math.abs(bs.Y - ts.Y)
                    local w = math.max(h * 0.55, 12)
                    local x = ts.X - w * 0.5
                    local y = ts.Y
                    local col
                    if t.IsNPC then
                        col = Config.ESP.NPCColor
                    elseif t.Player and LP.Team and t.Team
                    and t.Team == LP.Team then
                        col = Config.ESP.TeamColor
                    else
                        col = Config.ESP.EnemyColor
                    end
                    d.hl.Adornee = t.Character
                    d.hl.FillColor = col
                    d.hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    d.hl.Enabled = true
                    d.box.Visible = Config.ESP.Box
                    d.box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
                    d.box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
                    d.stroke.Color = col
                    d.name.Visible = Config.ESP.Name
                    d.name.Text = t.IsNPC and "NPC" or t.Label
                    d.name.TextColor3 = col
                    d.name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ts.X - 100, y - 18)
                    d.name.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 14)
                    d.name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                    d.dist.Visible = Config.ESP.Distance
                    d.dist.Text = string.format("[%dm]", math.floor(dist))
                    d.dist.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ts.X - 100, y + h + 2)
                    d.dist.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 12)
                    d.dist.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                    if Config.ESP.Health and t.Humanoid then
                        local hp = math.clamp(
                            t.Humanoid.Health / math.max(t.Humanoid.MaxHealth, 1),
                            0, 1)
                        d.hpBg.Visible = true
                        d.hpBg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 6, y)
                        d.hpBg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, h)
                        d.hpFill.Visible = true
                        d.hpFill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 6, y + h * (1 - hp))
                        d.hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, h * hp)
                        d.hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
                            math.floor(255*(1-hp)), math.floor(255*hp), 0)
                    else
                        d.hpBg.Visible = false
                        d.hpFill.Visible = false
                    end
                else hideESP(d) end
            else hideESP(d) end
        end
    end
    for char, d in pairs(espDrawings) do
        if not seen[char] or not char.Parent then
            hideESP(d)
            if not char.Parent then
                for _, part in pairs(d) do
                    if typeof(part) == "Instance" then
                        pcall(function() part:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
                espDrawings[char] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end

-- AIMBOT
local function aimCameraAt(target, part, smoothness)
    if not target or not part then return false end
    local cam = WS.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return false end
    local goal = CFrame.new(cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position)
    cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(goal, smoothness)
    return true
end

local function findBestTarget()
    if not Cam then Cam = WS.CurrentCamera end
    local center = viewportCenter()
    local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
    local lPos = localPos()
    if not lPos then return nil end
    local camPos = Cam.CFrame.Position
    for _, t in ipairs(scanAll()) do
        if t.IsNPC or not (LP.Team and t.Team and t.Team == LP.Team) then
            local part = Config.Aimbot.TargetPart == "Head" and t.Head or t.Root
            local sp, on = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
            if on and sp.Z > 0 then
                local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                if d <= Config.Aimbot.FOV and d < bestD then
                    -- Wall check: cast a ray from the camera to the target part
                    local pass = true
                    if Config.Aimbot.WallCheck then
                        pass = hasLineOfSight(camPos, part.Position, t)
                    end
                    if pass then
                        bestD = d; best = t
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function updateAimbot()
    if not Config.Aimbot.Enabled then return end
    if not UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then return end
    if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
    local target = findBestTarget()
    if not target then return end
    local part = Config.Aimbot.TargetPart == "Head" and target.Head or target.Root
    aimCameraAt(target, part, Config.Aimbot.Smoothness)
end

-- MISC (flight state)
local FlightBV = nil
local function flightStart()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end
    hum.PlatformStand = true
    if not FlightBV or FlightBV.Parent ~= hrp then
        if FlightBV then FlightBV:Destroy() end
        FlightBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        FlightBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
        FlightBV.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        FlightBV.P = 1000
        FlightBV.Parent = hrp
    end
end
local function flightStop()
    if FlightBV then FlightBV:Destroy(); FlightBV = nil end
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
    end
end

local function updateMisc()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum then return end

    -- WalkSpeed
    if Config.Misc.WalkSpeed.Enabled then
        hum.WalkSpeed = Config.Misc.WalkSpeed.Value
    end

    -- JumpPower
    if Config.Misc.JumpPower.Enabled then
        hum.UseJumpPower = true
        hum.JumpPower = Config.Misc.JumpPower.Value
    end

    -- NoClip
    if Config.Misc.NoClip then
        for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
                p.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    -- Flight
    if Config.Misc.Flight.Enabled then
        if not FlightBV or not hrp then
            flightStart()
        end
        if FlightBV and hrp then
            local cam = WS.CurrentCamera
            if cam then
                local move = Vector3.zero
                local speed = Config.Misc.Flight.Speed
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move = move + cam.CFrame.LookVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move = move - cam.CFrame.LookVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move = move - cam.CFrame.RightVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move = move + cam.CFrame.RightVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then move = move + Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then move = move - Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
                if move.Magnitude > 0 then move = move.Unit * speed end
                FlightBV.Velocity = move
            end
        end
    else
        if FlightBV then flightStop() end
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlayerColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)

-- GUI

Gui.Name = "ESP_Gui"

Gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -80)

local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
Corner.Parent = Frame

--==================================================
-- TITLE
--==================================================

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "Hack Menu"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Title.TextSize = 18
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Parent = Frame

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================

local Dragging = false
local DragStart
local StartPosition

Title.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)

    if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

        Dragging = true
        DragStart = Input.Position
        StartPosition = Frame.Position

        Input.Changed:Connect(function()

            if Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                Dragging = false
            end

        end)

    end

end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)

    if Dragging and Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then

        local Delta = Input.Position - DragStart

        Frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            StartPosition.X.Scale,
            StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
            StartPosition.Y.Scale,
            StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
        )

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- BUTTON CREATOR
--==================================================

local function CreateButton(Text, Position)

    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")

    Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
    Button.Position = Position
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 42)
    Button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    Button.TextSize = 14
    Button.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    Button.Text = Text
    Button.AutoButtonColor = true
    Button.Parent = Frame

    local ButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    ButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    ButtonCorner.Parent = Button

    return Button

end

--==================================================
-- BUTTONS
--==================================================

local GunButton = CreateButton(
    "Gun ESP: ON",
    UDim2.fromOffset(10, 35)
)

local PickupButton = CreateButton(
    "Pickup Gun: OFF",
    UDim2.fromOffset(10, 77)
)

local PlayerButton = CreateButton(
    "Player ESP: OFF",
    UDim2.fromOffset(10, 119)
)

-- GUN DRAWING
--==================================================

local GunLine = Drawing.new("Line")

GunLine.Visible = false
GunLine.Color = GunColor
GunLine.Thickness = 2
GunLine.Transparency = 1

local GunText = Drawing.new("Text")

GunText.Visible = false
GunText.Text = "GunDrop"
GunText.Color = GunColor
GunText.Size = 16
GunText.Center = true
GunText.Outline = true
GunText.OutlineColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

local GunHighlight
local LastGun

--==================================================
-- FIND GUN
--==================================================

local function GetGun()

    for _, Object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do

        if Object.Name == "GunDrop" then
            return Object
        end

    end

    return nil

end

--==================================================
-- GUN HIGHLIGHT
--==================================================

local function SetupGunHighlight(Gun)

    if GunHighlight then
        GunHighlight:Destroy()
        GunHighlight = nil
    end

    if Gun then

        GunHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

        GunHighlight.Name = "GunDropHighlight"
        GunHighlight.Adornee = Gun

        GunHighlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 255)
        GunHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.5

        GunHighlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
        GunHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0

        GunHighlight.DepthMode =
            Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop

        GunHighlight.Enabled = GunESP
        GunHighlight.Parent = Gun

    end

end

--==================================================
-- PLAYER ESP
--==================================================

local PlayerHighlights = {}
local PlayerTexts = {}

local function RemovePlayerESP(Player)

    if PlayerHighlights[Player] then
        PlayerHighlights[Player]:Destroy()
        PlayerHighlights[Player] = nil
    end

    if PlayerTexts[Player] then
        PlayerTexts[Player]:Remove()
        PlayerTexts[Player] = nil
    end

end

local function AddPlayerESP(Player)

    if Player == LocalPlayer then
        return
    end

    RemovePlayerESP(Player)

    local Character = Player.Character

    if not Character then
        return
    end

    local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

    Highlight.Name = "PlayerESP"
    Highlight.Adornee = Character
    Highlight.FillColor = PlayerColor
    Highlight.OutlineColor = PlayerColor
    Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.65
    Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    Highlight.DepthMode =
        Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop

    Highlight.Parent = Character

    PlayerHighlights[Player] = Highlight

    local Text = Drawing.new("Text")

    Text.Text = Player.DisplayName
    Text.Color = PlayerColor
    Text.Size = 16
    Text.Center = true
    Text.Outline = true
    Text.OutlineColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    Text.Visible = false

    PlayerTexts[Player] = Text

end

local function RefreshPlayerESP()

    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then

            if PlayerESP then
                AddPlayerESP(Player)
            else
                RemovePlayerESP(Player)
            end

        end

    end

end

--==================================================
-- PLAYER JOIN
--==================================================

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(Player)

    Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

        task.wait(0.5)

        if PlayerESP then
            AddPlayerESP(Player)
        end

    end)

end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)

    RemovePlayerESP(Player)

end)

--==================================================

    GunESP = not GunESP

        "Gun ESP: " .. (GunESP and "ON" or "OFF")

        GunText.Visible = false

        if GunHighlight then
            GunHighlight.Enabled = false
        end

    else

        if GunHighlight then
            GunHighlight.Enabled = true
        end

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- PICKUP GUN BUTTON
--==================================================

PickupButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    PickupGun = not PickupGun

    PickupButton.Text =
        "Pickup Gun: " .. (PickupGun and "ON" or "OFF")

end)

--==================================================
-- CONTINUOUS GUN BRING TO TORSO
--==================================================

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

    if not PickupGun then
        return
    end

    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not Character then
        return
    end

    -- R15 = UpperTorso
    -- R6  = Torso
    -- Fallback = HumanoidRootPart
    local Torso =
        Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not Torso then
        return
    end

    local Gun = GetGun()

    if not Gun then
        return
    end

    -- Move ONLY GunDrop to the torso
    local TargetCFrame = Torso.CFrame

    if Gun:IsA("Model") then

        Gun:PivotTo(TargetCFrame)

    elseif Gun:IsA("BasePart") then

        Gun.CFrame = TargetCFrame

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- PLAYER ESP BUTTON
--==================================================

PlayerButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    PlayerESP = not PlayerESP

    PlayerButton.Text =
        "Player ESP: " .. (PlayerESP and "ON" or "OFF")

    RefreshPlayerESP()

end)

--==================================================
-- GUN ESP UPDATE
--==================================================

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

    local Gun = GetGun()

    -- Detect new GunDrop
    if Gun ~= LastGun then

        LastGun = Gun

        if Gun then

            SetupGunHighlight(Gun)

        elseif GunHighlight then

            GunHighlight:Destroy()
            GunHighlight = nil

        end

    end

    if not GunESP or not Gun then

        GunLine.Visible = false
        GunText.Visible = false

        if GunHighlight then
            GunHighlight.Enabled = false
        end

        return

    end

    if GunHighlight then
        GunHighlight.Enabled = true
    end

    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    local Position

    if Gun:IsA("BasePart") then

        Position = Gun.Position

    elseif Gun:IsA("Model") then

        Position = Gun:GetPivot().Position

    end

    if not Position then

        GunLine.Visible = false
        GunText.Visible = false

        return

    end

    local ScreenPosition, OnScreen =
        Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Position)

    if OnScreen then

        local Mouse =
            UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

        GunLine.Visible = true
        GunText.Visible = true

        GunLine.From = Vector2.new(
            Mouse.X,
            Mouse.Y
        )

        GunLine.To = Vector2.new(
            ScreenPosition.X,
            ScreenPosition.Y
        )

        GunText.Position = Vector2.new(
            ScreenPosition.X,
            ScreenPosition.Y - 25
        )

    else

        GunLine.Visible = false
        GunText.Visible = false

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- PLAYER ESP UPDATE
--==================================================

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

    if not PlayerESP then
        return
    end

    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    for Player, Text in pairs(PlayerTexts) do

        local Character = Player.Character

        if Character then

            local Head = Character:FindFirstChild("Head")

            if Head then

                local ScreenPosition, OnScreen =
                    Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(
                        Head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                    )

                if OnScreen then

                    Text.Position = Vector2.new(
                        ScreenPosition.X,
                        ScreenPosition.Y
                    )

                    Text.Visible = true

                else

                    Text.Visible = false

                end

            else

                Text.Visible = false

            end

        else

            Text.Visible = false

        end

    end

end)

-- > Services
local UserInputService = game.GetService(game, 'UserInputService')
local Players = game.GetService(game, 'Players')

-- > Variables
local LocalPlayer, Camera = Players.LocalPlayer, workspace.CurrentCamera

-- > Functions
function GetClosestTarget(...)
    local Args = {...}
    if not Args then return nil end
    --
    local Target, Closest = nil, math.huge
    for Index, Value in next, Players.GetPlayers(Players) do
        if LocalPlayer == Value then continue end
        --
        local Character = Value.Character
        if not Character then continue end
        --
        local Head = game.FindFirstChild(Character, 'Head')
        if not Head then return Target end
        --
        local Humanoid = game.FindFirstChildOfClass(Character, 'Humanoid')
        if not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end
        --
        local Obscuring = Camera.GetPartsObscuringTarget(Camera, {Args[1], Head.Position}, {Character, LocalPlayer.Character})
        if #Obscuring > 0 then continue end
        --
        local Vector, OnScreen = Camera.WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, Head.Position)
        if not OnScreen then continue end
        --
        local Distance = (Vector2.new(Vector.X, Vector.Y) - UserInputService.GetMouseLocation(UserInputService)).Magnitude
        if Distance < Closest then Closest, Target = Distance, Head end
    end
    --
    return Target
end

-- > Connections
for Index, Value in next, getgc() do
    if typeof(Value) ~= 'function' then continue end
    --
    if debug.getinfo(Value).name == 'ProcessProjectiles' or debug.getinfo(Value).name == 'ProcessShot' then
		local Original; Original = hookfunction(Value, function(...)
            local Args = {...}
            --
            local Target = GetClosestTarget(Args[1]:GetBase().Tip.WorldPosition)
            if not Target then return Original(table.unpack(Args)) end
            --
            Args[3] = Target.Position
            return Original(table.unpack(Args))
        end)
    end
end
